title: Ambiguity Awareness Optimization: Towards Semantic Disambiguation for Direct Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Jian Li、Shenglin Yin、Yujia Zhang、Alan Zhao、Xi Chen、Xiaohui Zhou、Pengfei Xu（腾讯 OVB 人工智能技术中心、北京大学）
paper_type_zh: 词元级偏好数据加权与优化目标研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究当优选与劣选文本大量表达相同内容时，偏好回答对是否应被均匀消费的读者。
one_line: AAO reweights tokens in DPO preference pairs using their semantic similarity across chosen and rejected responses, reducing ambiguous supervision and emphasizing discriminative content.
AAO 根据优选与劣选回答之间的语义相似度为 DPO 回答对中的词元赋权，压制含混监督并强调区分性内容。
why: It makes semantic redundancy within a preference pair an auditable token-level training signal instead of letting identical content receive opposing DPO gradients.
inclusion_reason: It changes the training contribution of fields inside each preference record by using cross-answer semantic similarity to suppress ambiguous tokens and emphasize discriminative ones.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Chosen and rejected answers often share boilerplate, repeated facts, or semantically close wording. Ordinary DPO raises the probability of a token on the chosen path and lowers it on the rejected path even when the two occurrences express nearly the same content. The paper argues that these opposing token-level updates can cancel or confuse the contrastive signal instead of concentrating learning on the part that explains the preference.

AAO asks how an existing preference pair can separate semantically redundant background from content that actually distinguishes the two answers. It leaves the pair label and corpus intact, but changes the loss contribution of individual tokens. The decision boundary is therefore inside the training record, not at the level of discarding an entire chosen-rejected pair.

优选与劣选回答常共享套话、重复事实或语义接近的措辞。普通 DPO 会提高优选路径中某个词元的概率，并降低劣选路径中该词元的概率，即便两个出现位置表达的内容几乎相同。论文认为，这些相反的词元级更新可能相互抵消或混淆对比信号，而不是让学习集中在真正解释偏好的部分。

AAO 询问，既有偏好回答对如何将语义冗余的背景与真正区分两个回答的内容分开。它保持回答对标签和语料不变，却改变各个词元对损失的贡献。因此，其决策边界位于训练记录内部，而不是丢弃整条优选—劣选回答对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AAO represents every response token with the language model's embedding and compares it with all tokens in the opposite response. The normalized maximum cosine similarity marks how likely that token is to be ambiguous across the preference pair. Highly similar tokens are treated as background, low-similarity tokens as preference-bearing keys, and the middle region as transitional context.

The method suppresses ambiguous-token weights with a squared complement of similarity, preserves transitional tokens at one, and increases the weight of key tokens. A lightweight adaptive module predicts the two grouping thresholds from model outputs, while auxiliary contrastive and chosen-reward losses train that module. The result is a DPO-compatible token-weighted record rather than a new preference label.

AAO 用语言模型的嵌入表示每个回答词元，并将其与另一回答中的所有词元比较。归一化后的最大余弦相似度标记该词元在偏好回答对中成为含混内容的可能性。高度相似的词元被视为背景，低相似度词元被视为承载偏好的关键内容，中间区域则是过渡上下文。

该方法用相似度补值的平方压低含混词元权重，将过渡词元保持为一，并提高关键词元权重。一个轻量级自适应模块从模型输出预测两个分组阈值，辅助的对比损失与优选奖励损失训练该模块。其结果是与 DPO 兼容的词元加权记录，而不是新的偏好标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a chosen-rejected pair, AAO obtains token embeddings from the model and computes each token's maximum normalized similarity to the tokens of the other answer. An MLP predicts ordered thresholds a and b from output logits. Similarity above a yields an ambiguity weight of (1-S)^2, similarity below b yields a key-token weight of 1+S, and the middle region has weight one; a differentiable approximation permits threshold learning. These weights are applied to output logits in the preference optimization.

The authors run one-epoch AdamW training with batch size 16 and learning rate 5e-7 on Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, each in base and instruction-tuned form. Open-domain runs use UltraFeedback after base models are prepared with UltraChat-200k; safety runs use Anthropic-HH after Alpaca preparation. Comparisons include DPO, IPO, KTO, SimPO, TDPO, RTO, TIS-DPO, and a randomly weighted DPO control.

对于一条优选—劣选回答对，AAO 从模型取得词元嵌入，并计算每个词元与另一回答词元之间的最大归一化相似度。一个多层感知机从输出 logits 预测有序阈值 a 与 b。相似度高于 a 时得到 (1-S)^2 的含混权重，低于 b 时得到 1+S 的关键词元权重，中间区域权重为一；可微近似使阈值能够学习。这些权重被施加到偏好优化的输出 logits 上。

作者在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 的基础版和指令版上，以批大小 16、学习率 5e-7 的 AdamW 训练一个轮次。开放域实验让基础模型先经 UltraChat-200k 准备，再使用 UltraFeedback；安全实验让模型先经 Alpaca 准备，再使用 Anthropic-HH。比较对象包括 DPO、IPO、KTO、SimPO、TDPO、RTO、TIS-DPO 以及随机加权的 DPO 对照。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Llama-3.1-8B-Base, AAO reports a 28.36% length-controlled AlpacaEval 2 win rate, 40.23% raw win rate, 7.52 MT-Bench score, 41.0% Arena-Hard win rate, and 91.29% harmless-response rate. The corresponding DPO values are 22.45%, 31.30%, 7.36, 26.0%, and 83.06%. On the instruction-tuned version, Arena-Hard rises from 29.6% for DPO to 42.7% for AAO.

The method-specific evidence is the weighting ablation. On the Llama base setting, the proposed curve obtains 28.36% length-controlled win rate and 41.00% Arena-Hard, while its alternative curves range from 18.56% to 27.98% and 24.69% to 38.84%. The reported overhead is 62.50 MB and 78.12 versus 77.81 minutes of Mistral training, supporting the claim that the added weighting is lightweight in that setup.

在 Llama-3.1-8B-Base 上，AAO 报告的 AlpacaEval 2 长度控制胜率为 28.36%、原始胜率为 40.23%、MT-Bench 分数为 7.52、Arena-Hard 胜率为 41.0%、无害回答率为 91.29%。对应的 DPO 数值为 22.45%、31.30%、7.36、26.0% 与 83.06%。在指令微调版本上，Arena-Hard 从 DPO 的 29.6% 提升至 AAO 的 42.7%。

方法特有的证据来自权重消融。在 Llama 基础设置上，所提曲线取得 28.36% 的长度控制胜率与 41.00% 的 Arena-Hard 胜率，而替代曲线的范围分别为 18.56% 至 27.98% 和 24.69% 至 38.84%。报告的额外开销为 62.50 MB，Mistral 训练时间从 77.81 分钟增至 78.12 分钟，支持其在该设置中加权机制较轻量的主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Token-level DPO work commonly estimates importance from probability, advantage, or optimization behavior. AAO changes a different property: semantic overlap between the two members of the stored preference pair. The same answer text can therefore receive less learning influence when it is a background statement repeated on both sides, even if its raw token probability is high.

Its adaptive thresholds make the semantic partition part of the trained mechanism rather than a fixed preprocessing rule. The paper also keeps a deliberately neutral transitional group instead of forcing every token to be either discarded or emphasized. This isolates a concrete training-use claim: semantic redundancy inside a pair is a separate source of ambiguous supervision.

词元级 DPO 工作通常从概率、优势或优化行为估计重要性。AAO 改变的是另一项属性：存储的偏好回答对两个成员之间的语义重叠。因此，同一段回答文本在两侧都是重复背景陈述时，即便原始词元概率较高，也会获得较小的学习影响。

其自适应阈值让语义划分成为已训练机制的一部分，而非固定的预处理规则。论文还保留了刻意中性的过渡组，而不是强迫每个词元非被丢弃即被强调。这隔离出一个具体的训练使用主张：回答对内部的语义冗余是含混监督的独立来源。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors state that the ambiguity argument still needs a more rigorous analysis of gradient dynamics, and their piecewise similarity curve is empirically motivated rather than proven optimal. Semantic similarity is generated from the training model's own embeddings, so the grouping can inherit representation bias or fail when the same word has different task-relevant meanings. The helpfulness evidence relies substantially on automated LLM judges, and the paper reports no broad contamination or label-quality audit of the source preference data.
作者指出，含混性论证仍需要对梯度动态做更严格的分析，其分段相似度曲线出于经验动机而非被证明最优。语义相似度由训练模型自身的嵌入产生，因此分组可能继承表征偏差，或在同一词语拥有不同任务相关含义时失效。帮助性证据在很大程度上依赖自动化大模型评判，论文也没有报告对源偏好数据的广泛污染或标签质量审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use AAO when preference pairs are long and share much wording, and the training team wants to preserve all pairs while reducing token-level conflict. It is especially useful for testing whether apparent preference learning comes from discriminative content rather than shared boilerplate. Before reuse, inspect examples of the three token groups, check the cost of all-pairs cross-answer similarity for target sequence lengths, and separately validate safety and task quality with human or task-grounded evaluation.
当偏好回答对较长、共享大量措辞，而训练团队希望保留所有回答对并减少词元级冲突时，可以使用 AAO。它尤其适合检验表面上的偏好学习是否来自区分性内容，而非共享套话。复用前应查看三类词元的示例，检查针对目标序列长度计算跨回答全对相似度的成本，并用人工或任务锚定的评估分别验证安全性与任务质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the common-token gradient argument before treating similarity as a quality score: AAO is meant to reduce a contradictory update, not to claim that repeated content is intrinsically bad. Then inspect the weight-curve ablation and the fixed transitional weight, because these are the choices that make semantic similarity affect optimization. Finally, compare raw and length-controlled AlpacaEval values alongside Arena-Hard and the safety rate; no single judge score establishes that token suppression preserves all useful detail.
在把相似度视为质量分数之前，应先阅读共同词元的梯度论证：AAO 的目的在于减少矛盾更新，而不是宣称重复内容本身不好。随后检查权重曲线消融与固定的过渡词元权重，因为正是这些选择让语义相似度影响优化。最后把原始与长度控制的 AlpacaEval 数值同 Arena-Hard 和安全率一起比较；没有任何单一评判分数能够证明词元压制保留了所有有用细节。
